title: Enable a user account using the command line
summary: Use the `pwpolicy` command to enable a previously disabled user account, allowing them to log in again. This requires administrator privileges.

steps.explain: Run the pwpolicy command with sudo to enable the specified user account.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The short name of the user account to enable

rollback.explain: To disable the user again, use the disableuser flag with pwpolicy.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The short name of the user account to disable

warnings: Enabling an account allows the user to log in. Ensure this is intended.
This does not restore deleted accounts, only re-enables disabled ones.
